input.prompt:
Generate ONE complete 3200x1440 finished landscape mobile game screen. Image1 is the NEW modern dark-occult HD-pixel battle art master. Preserve the ENTIRE shared UI from Image1: header, three tabs, resources, both matching vertical card lanes, card artwork, badges, locks, exact boundaries, type scale and spacing. Replace ONLY the central page content. Image2 is an official gothic art reference, subordinate to Image1; it may inform scene craft but never change the master's UI or game rules.

Absolute latest rule: BACKPACK IS THE SAME FULL-WIDTH VERTICAL CARD SYSTEM AS EQUIPMENT. Same card width, height, border, surface, row spacing and lock style on left and right. No two-column grid, no split square cells. Right bag is empty. Keep the same existing empty cards as Image1, with no cloned items or invented values.
Keep exactly 装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴, first selected. Header remains 生命180/180, 体力100/100, 腐化0/100 EMPTY, 金币4. Left card art remains one green vial, one pale single-cap mushroom, one diagonal silver dagger, no permanent item-name paragraphs. Badges remain vial8/1, mushroom recycle4 only, dagger30/2 and empty charge0/100 with one small edge enchant mark. These values describe equipped samples, not merchandise prices.

Keep the master's FINE, high-density pixel craftsmanship and rich, coherent material lighting. Glass has thickness; metal has facets; stone has mass; cloth has deep restrained color. Clear shapes and controlled highlights, no coarse enlarged sprites or random stipple. Quiet functional surfaces, slim precise edges, modern clean Chinese text. No old RPG bevel stacks, full-screen stone wallpaper, giant Song/Ming type or glowing UI flourishes. Dark occult character is carried by the world and deliberate forms. Preserve the master's overall tonal and color relationships rather than applying a fresh unrelated color grade.

Inside the central region, retain the title baseline. Bottom controls share one consistent row and common height, aligned with each other. Primary action anchors at bottom-right, secondary action at bottom-left. Keep labels readable and large. Empty space must remain UNFRAMED negative space, not a blank button, card or placeholder. No additional resources, fees, timers, branding or game systems. Fully finished generated game screenshot only, no process annotation or comparison board.

CENTRAL PAGE 行商, purchase view.
Small highly crafted pixel hooded merchant portrait beside title, under8% of central area. Face in deep controlled shadow with one rim-lit plane, not a giant painterly torso. Local tabs 购买 / 出售 directly below the title, first selected, quieter than the main action.
Main body: left32% for three uniform stock entries 淬毒利刃 / 凝血毒剂 / 灵魂香菇, right64% for selected item. Match stock silhouettes to the existing equipment; do not use a different dagger design or unrelated potion model. Select a BRONZE merchandise dagger, separate from the silver equipped instance.
Selected detail: 淬毒利刃, 青铜, a medium finely drawn dagger icon; dark quiet background and one left-aligned text column with these exact effects, full legibility:
充能后：下3次攻击造成15剧毒伤害。
持续3回合 · 会心几率30%
每8次剧毒，施加1层易伤。
Use at most three text sizes in detail, adequate line spacing, no tiny footnote treatment. Material craft and pixel control should make the weapon desirable without filling the page with ornament. Keep the shop icon/detail style part of the same game as the equipped dagger.
Bottom has TWO actual buttons: 离开商店 at left and 购买所选装备 at right. The middle is plain UNFRAMED dark negative space; do not draw an empty third button. No invented purchase price and no developer placeholders like 暂无报价 or 待配置. Gold remains4 and the right full-width bag cards remain empty. Preserve every component outside the central region.
